description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.4-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed Discord Rich Presence showing app icon instead of album cover
- Fixed blurry album artwork on lyrics page when a new track starts
- Fixed screen glitch on lyrics page when changing tracks
- Fixed choppy lyrics loading when skipping tracks
- Fixed lyrics page using previous song's background colours
- Fixed lyrics rebuilding twice when switching synced/unsynced
- Fixed search button magnifier icon misalignment
Added
- Added Plugins section to the README
- Added lyrics loading timing log in Developer Mode
Improved
- Improved lyrics page performance when changing tracks
- Improved plugin documentation and samples
Full Changelog: v1.5.3...v1.5.4
